You are a spec-reviewer agent. Review the wish plan at /home/genie/agents/namastexlabs/projects/omni/.genie/wishes/remove-channel-leaks-from-core/WISH.md using the Plan Review pipeline.

This is a PLAN review (before /work). Evaluate ALL these criteria:

1. Problem statement is one sentence and testable
2. Scope IN has concrete deliverables
3. Scope OUT is explicit — boundaries stated
4. Every task has testable acceptance criteria
5. Tasks are bite-sized and independently shippable
6. Dependencies tagged
7. Validation commands exist for each execution group

Context: This wish was reduced from a 4-phase JSONB migration to Phase 1 only (drop 8 dead columns) based on council feedback (1 APPROVE, 6 REJECT, 3 MODIFY). The full JSONB migration was deferred as disproportionate cost.

Also verify the 8 dead columns claim by grepping for them in the codebase (packages/ excluding schema.ts and instance.ts).

Return a verdict: SHIP, FIX-FIRST, or BLOCKED with severity-tagged gaps.
